faqs.q1: How do I scan a receipt?
faqs.a1: Tap the 'Scan Receipt' button and take a photo or choose from gallery. Our AI will automatically extract details.
faqs.a2: Yes, tap the 'Add Manual' button on the home screen to enter details without a receipt.
faqs.q3: How do I see my monthly reports?
faqs.a3: Tap 'View All Reports' to see detailed spending breakdown and analytics.
faqs.a4: We use industry-standard encryption and Supabase for secure data storage.
faqs.a5: Tap on any transaction to see details, then tap the trash icon to remove it.
faqs.a6: Currently, an internet connection is required to sync with our AI and database.
faqs.q7: How do I change my currency?
faqs.a7: Currency preferences can be set in the Profile section (coming soon).
faqs.q8: What if the AI misses an item?
faqs.a8: You can always edit transaction details or individual items manually.
faqs.a9: CSV and PDF export features are currently in development.
faqs.q10: How do I reset my password?
faqs.a10: Password reset can be initiated from the Auth screen via email.
